§6Particle Accelerator§f

§aSmash particles at relativistic speeds. Build exotic matter. Try not to crash the beam.§f

The §bParticle Accelerator§f is a modular end-game machine that collides particles to create antimatter, antischrabidium, dark matter, and other exotic byproducts. It comes in §blinear§f (straight) and §bsynchrotron§f (square ring) designs.

§6Components§f:
§b•§f §bParticle Source§f, creates the beam from two input items
§b•§f §bRF Cavity§f, +100 acceleration, +100 defocus. Crash at 1000 defocus
§b•§f §bQuadrupole Magnets§f, -100 defocus. Needs coils to function
§b•§f §bDipole Magnets§f, redirects around corners. Synchrotron only
§b•§f §bParticle Detector§f, accepts particles at §e0 defocus§f and executes recipes

§6Coils§f (determine operational range):
§b•§f §bGold§f: 0-2,200, min dipole side 15
§b•§f §bNbTi§f: 1,500-8,400, min 21
§b•§f §bBSCCO§f: 7,500-15,000, min 27
§b•§f §bChlorophyte§f: 14,500-75,000, min 51

Below-min coils: §e10x§f power penalty. Stack two penalties: §e100x§f, particle crashes. All components need §bcold perfluoromethyl§f cooling.

§cWARNING:§f Calculate power needs before building. You need multiple MHE. Fission or fusion must sustain it. Design in creative first.
